subject: Request: Same-day demo tonight (APAC evening) — timezone clarification
messages:

Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@ignition.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 19:15:00 +0800
Subject: Request: Same-day demo tonight (20:30 HKT) — urgent

Hi Vivek —

Apologies for the late note. Our execs just confirmed travel and would love a quick product walkthrough tonight at 20:30 HKT (we're in Hong Kong). It's short notice I know — can your team do a 30-minute tailored demo focused on latency, dedicated capacity options, and the VPC/private deployment story?

Quick context: Ignition's CTO will be in the APAC office tonight and can join for 20:30 HKT only. We previously misread PST/PDT labels when booking and ended up with a scheduling mix last month, so I'm trying to be explicit on timezones here.

Proposed: 20:30 HKT / 12:30 UTC / 04:30 PST — 30 minutes, Zoom.

Attachments: demo_agenda_v2.pdf (contains a short 3-slide ask list).

Would really appreciate a yes/no in the next hour so I can confirm with the CTO.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Chan
Head of Platform Partnerships | Ignition AI
[sophie.chan@ignition.ai]

Subject: Re: Request: Same-day demo tonight (20:30 HKT) — urgent

Looping you both in — Sophie just asked for a same-day demo at 20:30 HKT (that's 04:30 PST / 12:30 UTC).

Laura — can EU coverage pick this up or do we want to use on-call rotation? Marcus — would you be able to present a short demo if we need engineering presence? We should be explicit on what we demo so we avoid long deep-dives:
- 10m quick overview (hosted + dedicated)
- 10m performance story (latency, batch/caching) + benchmarks
- 10m Q&A / next steps (procurement + security)

If we can do it I'll confirm with Sophie and send an invite. If not, suggest earliest alternate slots (I gave Sophie 20:30 HKT as requested).

Action items:
- Laura: confirm coverage or nominate a presenter (cc: any CS on-call)
- Marcus: confirm if you can join from on-call (we'll offer overtime comp if needed)

Thanks — will hold until I hear back (Sophie asked for answer in the hour).

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
